research.title: Predictive Uncertainty Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare conformal prediction intervals under controlled covariate shifts, specifying data splits and evaluation criteria.
Evaluated marginal coverage and interval width across reweighting strategies, documenting sensitivity to density ratio estimation and calibration sample composition.

work.title: Order Documentation and Inventory Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming order forms for missing information, maintained filing records, and routed discrepancies to the appropriate staff for resolution.
Updated inventory logs from delivery receipts, prepared routine supply requests, and coordinated collection of outstanding paperwork before scheduled order processing.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge, lasso, and elastic net regression workflows with standardized predictors and nested cross validation for selecting regularization parameters.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability on simulated correlated features, examining how predictor redundancy affected variable selection across repeated splits.

projects.title: Probability Calibration for Imbalanced Classification
bullets: Implemented logistic regression and random forest baselines with sigmoid and isotonic calibration, keeping calibration data separate from final evaluation.
Compared Brier scores, reliability diagrams, and precision recall curves under varying class proportions, documenting differences between discrimination and probability accuracy.

projects.title: Mixture Models for Clustering Overlapping Distributions
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixture models and compared clustering assignments with k means on synthetic data with overlapping components.
Evaluated held out log likelihood and adjusted Rand scores, examining sensitivity to initialization, covariance assumptions, and the specified component count.
